summary: Iteration 26 retest of the iteration 25 bugs. All 6 fixes verified, and nothing regressed. Backend: 17/17 pytest pass (5 new iter26 tests plus the 12 iter25 regression tests, including live LLM chat language and question-cap runs). Frontend checks: (1) UserDetailModal and the shared admin Modal (Accounts > Add account) now render as direct children of document.body. Their overlay covers the full viewport at 1920x800 and at 390x844, the modals are centred inside the viewport, and the close buttons can be clicked. (2) HealthChat: new-screening-btn, chat-input and chat-send-btn are disabled while a session is created or opened (about 2.4s here) and while a reply streams, and the session list buttons are disabled during streaming. A message sent after New Screening is stored in the NEW session (checked in the DB), stays visible, and reloading /chat reopens the same session. For a brand-new user with no session, the first message (Arabic) creates a session and keeps the greeting, the message and an Arabic reply; an English follow-up gets an English reply. (3) Sign-in method shows 'Email & password', 'Google' and 'Email & password + Google' correctly. (4) New registrations show 'Signed in just now'. (5) The Google session endpoint rejects suspended users with 403 SUSPENDED_MSG (code check). (6) Fast filter changes on the Users list end with the correct final results, and the admin-overview-loading skeleton appears.

minor.issue: sign_in_method is '—' for a user with no password_hash and no auth_providers (an old example.com test user). Older users who registered before the fix still show 'Signed in never' (e.g. farahghabayen97@gmail.com). Consider backfilling last_login_at from created_at.

issues: The overlay (z-50) does not cover the staging banner at the top. Cosmetic only.

Arabic text in chat bubbles showed as unjoined letters in headless Chromium. The body font stack only includes IBM Plex Sans Arabic when html lang=ar. Add 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic' as a fallback to the default stack so Arabic replies render properly in English mode.
On reload, the end-of-messages scrollIntoView scrolls the whole window past the TriageCard.
Date of Birth uses the browser's native date input instead of a shadcn calendar.

action_items: Optional: add 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic' to the default font stack so Arabic chat text renders when the UI is in English
Optional: backfill last_login_at for users created before the register fix
critical_code_review_comments: HealthChat openReq guard and the opening/streaming disable logic are correct. The mount-restore effect is now skipped once any open or new action has started (openReq.current > 0).
Users.jsx uses a live flag plus a debounced clearTimeout, so stale responses are ignored.
Admin modals: createPortal is used in both UserDetailModal and ui.jsx Modal.
seed_data_creation: Created test_iter26*@example.com patients plus 1 chat session, then deleted them. Omar now has an extra active chat session containing TEST_RACE26 messages. No suspended or demo states were left changed (the iter25 fixture restores solo.patient).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter25 bugs are fixed. Preview API latency is about 2-4s. Onboarding 'Skip for now' gets a new user to /chat. The real-user list has 10 users and 47 demo accounts are hidden.
